items.stem: Revenue leakage in a subscription business most accurately refers to:

options.text: Revenue the company was entitled to but did not bill or collect
options.rationale: Correct: leakage is earned-but-unbilled or uncollected revenue, not only fraud.

options.text: Only revenue lost to deliberate customer fraud
options.rationale: Fraud is one cause; most leakage is from process and configuration errors.
Tax remittance is not revenue leakage.

items.explanation: Correct: leakage is revenue the business was entitled to but failed to bill or collect.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO are examples of a detective control over billing? (Select TWO)

options.text: An exception report flagging usage with no matching charge
options.rationale: Correct: an exception report detects anomalies after processing.

options.text: A usage-to-billing reconciliation run each period
options.rationale: Correct: a reconciliation detects mismatches after billing.

options.text: A mandatory approval before a price plan can be activated
options.rationale: That is a preventive control, acting before the event.

options.text: A field validation that blocks an invalid tariff at entry
options.rationale: Input validation is preventive, not detective.

items.explanation: Correct: exception reports and reconciliations are detective controls; approvals and input validation are preventive.

items.stem: A leakage finding is reported as '1,200 affected accounts' with no monetary figure. What is missing?

options.text: Quantification of the financial impact of the leakage
options.rationale: Correct: findings must be sized financially to be actionable.

options.text: The names of the affected customers
options.rationale: Customer names are not what makes the finding actionable.
The system version is not the missing element.
A marketing plan is unrelated to sizing leakage.

items.explanation: Correct: a leakage finding needs its financial impact quantified to prioritise recovery.
